title: Should a shallow-clone base fail ste-lint, or stay unknown with exit 0?
home: decision stale-cites-at-merge (stale prose check at merge), line 14
context:
Goal: ste-lint never passes a PR it could not read.
Problem (rule): On branch ste-lint-diff-fail-closed (head 9c43a817), run.sh stops with 'ste-lint: unknown' and exit 1 when its git diff cannot read the range. Your 2026-11-01 ruling in stale-cites-at-merge says a base that does not resolve (a shallow clone) is unknown and exits 0, so a child that pins the action and checks out shallow is not red at its pin move. The two rulings conflict, so this needs your word.
Based on (measured): with the fix, lint/test_stale_cites.py test_step_with_an_unresolvable_base_exits_zero goes red (rc 1, 'no merge base'); the 6 new cases in actions/ste-lint/test_action.py go green.
Based on (notes): Which children check out shallow is unmeasured. run.sh's own fallback fetch uses --depth=1, which also leaves no merge base.
Departs from: main exits 0 on an unreadable base — the step exits 1, and stale-cites-at-merge line 14 is rewritten to match.

options.label: Fail closed always (Recommended)
options.how: Keep 9c43a817. Re-point the stale test to expect rc 1 and 'ste-lint: unknown'. Rewrite stale-cites-at-merge line 14. Each child's re-pin lane also sets fetch-depth 0.
options.gain: No PR passes lint unread, whether it comes from a bad base or a shallow clone.
options.lose: A child that re-pins without fetch-depth 0 goes red until it sets it.

options.label: Shallow stays exit 0
options.how: When git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository is true, print unknown and exit 0. Fail closed only in a full clone.
options.gain: No child goes red at its re-pin.
options.lose: A shallow child is never linted, and the log says unknown on every run.

options.label: Deepen, then fail closed
options.how: When the diff read fails in a shallow clone, the step runs git fetch --unshallow once and tries again. It fails closed if the read still fails.
options.gain: Children stay green and get linted.
options.lose: Each shallow run adds one full fetch, and the step does more.
